method: Composite classification (not advice): equal-ish blend of valuation, growth, quality (ROE/FCF margin), leverage and 6-12m momentum. Letter grade + 0-100 score. Tilted to reward the 2026 rotation into cash-generative real-economy leaders and to penalize richly-valued momentum names showing distribution.

names.note: Sector leadership, ~$19B TTM FCF, fortress balance sheet, dividend + buyback; price up with oil.
Industrial-cycle and electrification/datacenter capex beneficiary; strong FCF and pricing power.
Best-in-class defensive compounder; membership moat, steady comps, low leverage. Rich multiple is the only knock.
Integrated major with ~$14B FCF, low net debt, high shareholder returns; momentum with energy leadership.
Cheapest mega-cap chip name (DCF implies only ~6.5% FCF growth), strong FCF/buyback; handset cyclicality the risk.
Unmatched ~$119B TTM FCF and net cash; quality elite, but momentum cooling as AI-capex payback is questioned.
Uranium up-cycle leader, +~100% 1y, real contracts (India, Cigar Lake stake up); momentum strong, valuation full.
High-margin AI-datacenter networking, net cash, strong ROE; off its highs, reasonable vs peers.
Custom-AI-silicon + software, huge FCF and dividend growth; leverage from VMware and rich multiple temper it.
Domestic solar with policy tailwind and large backlog; net cash. Volatile and policy-sensitive.
Operating leverage + crypto/retail tape, $20M insider buy; profitability improving but tape-dependent.
Well-capitalized regional bank, repeated CEO buying, reasonable valuation on tangible book.
Nuclear baseload for AI/datacenter demand; down ~25% YTD makes it the relative-value play in the power theme.

worst.note: Premier franchise but extreme valuation; ~9% post-earnings drop signals a momentum break despite beat-and-raise.
Among the most expensive large-caps on sales/FCF; price rolling over from highs — valuation risk dominates.
Pre-profit quantum; fell ~10% on Rigetti competition. Story stock, no FCF, high dilution risk.
Great franchise, but after a massive run trades at a stretched multiple; reward/risk poor near highs.
Leveraged uranium beta with negative EPS (-$0.11 latest Q); speculative vs CCJ's cash flows.
